# rag-eval

> Offline evaluation of RAG results: recall@k, precision@k, MRR, nDCG@k and SQuAD-style answer metrics, with CI thresholds. Python package `trysac-rag-eval`, import name `rag_eval`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies, no LLM calls.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests
